name: Shenzhen Dobot Corp Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Dobot Corp Ltd specializes in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of collaborative robots, known as "cobots" in China and Hong Kong. The company's cobots are categorized into two types: four-axis cobots and six-axis cobots. It sells its six-axis cobots under the CR Series and the Nova Series. The company's four-axis cobot series primarily consist of Magician Series and M Series. Its four-axis cobots are used for desktop-level use cases and light manufacturing use cases, such as labeling and electronic component testing processes. It also offers integrated cobots for use in various industries, such as palletizing, welding, mobile operation, and vocational training. …
